scope: Official Unity CLI/Pipeline supply inventory and call-boundary review; one isolated proposal file.
noAcceptanceClaim: This candidate is ready for human review. It grants no installation, license, model, network or Editor permission and does not complete M1-03 acceptance.

inputs.qualification: Reachable merged source, consumed as a candidate inventory with explicit blocked/unknown rows. Publication is not tool approval.
inputs.drift: Producer used an older manifest/lock. This review recomputes the Pipeline dependency closure at baseRef; historical hashes and observations stay historical.

inputs.qualification: Reachable candidate with policy hash, capability, failed attempts and limits. Its bound execution-profile file hash equals this baseRef.
inputs.limits: Producer decision simulation only; not rerun here. No OS sandbox, network egress, MCP enforcement or independent acceptance proof.

toolInventory.historicalDigestQualification: Reported tarball digest at 2026-09-08 baseCommit f2011ac2cd4510a09c78f0de111771fc5aa433e8; no distribution bytes re-fetched or rehashed in this review.

pipelineDependencies.scope: Complete recursive closure reachable from com.unity.pipeline in this baseRef lock; excludes unrelated project packages and CLI/client internal dependencies.
pipelineDependencies.interpretation: Declared and resolved versions are different fields. Differences are recorded, not silently rewritten or called runtime compatibility PASS.
pipelineDependencies.integrityLimit: Registry lock entries contain no distribution digest. Builtin packages need binding to the exact Editor distribution; an absent registry tarball does not make builtin package bytes unverifiable.
pipelineDependencies.licenseLimit: No version-matched CLI/Pipeline/dependency license files are tracked in the inspected base tree. Unrelated repository license files do not license these packages.

flow: official Unity CLI command with explicit project path
risks: A shell caller can bypass native MCP client disabled_tools; apply the same role, path, approval and tool policy before launch.
Credentials, network requests and configuration discovery by the executable are not audited from the lockfile.
A manual stdout result reaches a model only if the caller forwards it; an agent-shell result may already enter its model context.
callBoundaries.requiredEvidence: Exact binary/package provenance and instrumented permitted/denied direct invocations in a synthetic scoped project.

flow: MCP result to client; provider forwarding depends on client configuration
risks: stdio is a local transport, not proof of offline operation or blocked provider egress.
Nested calls and direct shell equivalents must preserve deny policy; client settings alone are not an OS boundary.
Image/screenshot results must not be forwarded to the coding LLM under the standing instruction. Text results still require classification and redaction.
callBoundaries.requiredEvidence: Per-tool exposure, direct/nested deny cases and redacted result/destination receipts tied to policyHash.

flow: Pi extension host, only if separately adopted
result back through adapter to Pi
risks: Adapter host privileges, configuration and output transformations are additional review surfaces if adopted.
callBoundaries.requiredEvidence: No requirement for native direct paths; if adopted, test equivalent tool and nested-call denials without broader permission.

toolExposureProposal.modelOutputRule: No images/screenshots to the coding LLM. Before any text result egress, bind allowed data class, destination and role to the execution profile.
toolExposureProposal.configurationEvidence: ADR reports historical Codex disabled_tools and Claude Code deny settings. Current settings, exposed names and OS enforcement were not inspected or changed; never publish private configs.

checks.command: inspection: dependency-contract, manifest/lock, ADR 0006 and license files
checks.observed: Pipeline manifest/lock pin agrees; closure has no missing lock node. Source digests and producer profile match checked. Package license files absent from Git; historical license disagreement retained.
checks.negativeCase: CLI/client/adapter unpinned fields and license/hash gaps remain null/unknown; Pipeline license remains conflicting.

checks.reason: Test path absent in base tree. Candidate write scope is docs/team/M1-03 only; no boundary harness or approved exact executable/package evidence is available for this review.

historicalObservation.qualification: Historical capability smoke only, not repeated for this commit; package materialization is not functional/network/voice PASS.
historicalObservation.laterObservation: The separate 2026-09-08 closing note reports a timeout during restart and one final Console error without another verification. Earlier zero-error results are not the final session state.
